{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit crewneck sweater, slightly fitted, hip length, deep burgundy #6D2434, merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, full ankle length, charcoal #3A3D42, lined wool-blend twill
Thermal base layer leggings, ankle length, worn under the trousers, black #1A1A1A, fine merino wool
Hooded puffer coat, knee length, belted at the waist, navy #1F2A44, water-repellent shell with down fill
Ankle boots, low block heel, grippy rubber sole, black #1A1A1A, waterproof treated leather
Knee-high socks, charcoal melange #4A4D52, thick wool blend
Long scarf, wrapped twice, camel #B58B5A, soft wool
Beanie, close-fitting, charcoal #3A3D42, ribbed wool
Gloves, tailored, black #1A1A1A, cashmere-blend knit with a warm lining
Structured tote bag, taupe #8B7D6B, water-resistant coated leather
Leather ballet flats for the office, kept in the tote, black #1A1A1A, smooth leather

This outfit suits a neat business office and a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow. The merino base layer and the lined trousers keep the cold out without adding bulk, and the knee-length down coat covers the long walk. The waterproof boots with a grippy sole handle snow and road salt, and the flats in your bag let you change into office shoes on arrival. The burgundy sweater against charcoal and navy looks polished and calm, and the camel scarf adds warmth to the palette."}
